<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/folders/{folder_id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetch one folder by id.

Returns a single `folder` envelope. If the folder does not exist in
the caller's project, `count` is `0` and `folder` is omitted.
